text:
Maria K: kicking off preflight for Cassia private rollout (v2.3.1 -> v2.3.2). planned change window 2026-05-12T02:00-03:30Z. tagging eng-releases for go/no-go. release notes: https://redwood-internal/releases/cassia/v2.3.2

Deploy-bot: deploy plan created. starting canary -> cassia-private-prod-canary slice-1. Canary traffic 2%. pinned runtime: runtime-1.8.4, quant profile: q4_8. If canary healthy, shift 25% every 10m.

Sam B: quick check — customer KMS is customer-kms-01. @Lia M can you confirm no KMS rotations in this window?

Lia M: KMS team confirms: no rotation scheduled. good to go. :white_check_mark:

Bharat P: adding probes: /v1/health and a user-facing trace sample. setting alert: p99 >= 3s notify, but rollback thresholds per ops below.

Ops-oncall: rollback triggers we agreed: p99 >= 7s for 10m OR error_rate >= 5% for 10m -> abort and rollback. Rollback procedure = pin back to v2.3.1 + revert cache profile to pre-deploy snapshot.

Maria K: acknowledged. @Deploy-bot please apply rollback thresholds to this rollout.

Deploy-bot: rollback thresholds applied: p99>=7s (600s) OR error_rate>=0.05 (600s). Canary started 02:05Z. logs: https://internal-logs/deploys/cassia/3245678901/canary.log

Sam B: seeing ~10% bump in token latency at 02:12Z in canary — monitoring. not yet at threshold. :eyes:

Lia M: applying temporary traffic shaping to canary slice to reduce concurrency. patch: ```curl -X POST https://infra-api/internal/traffic -d '{"slice":"cassia-canary-1","max_concurrent":40}'```

Bharat P: metrics stabilized after shaping. p99 back to ~2.8s. proceed with first 25% shift at 02:25Z.

Maria K: shifted to 25% -> 50% traffic now. please watch the next 15m window.

Ops-oncall: ack. 15m observation window starting. If anything crosses threshold, we initiate rollback plan.

Deploy-bot: traffic at 50% as of 02:32Z. no rollback triggers so far. next scheduled shift 02:40Z -> 75%.

Sam B: slight error rate uptick to 1.2% at 02:36Z, correlating with larger-than-usual prompt sizes from a subset of requests. within acceptable margin.

Lia M: doing KV cache warmup on canary nodes to mitigate cold-cache tail latency: ```redis-cli --scan | xargs -L1000 redis-cli MGET```

Bharat P: after cache warmup, p99 back down to 2.6s. safe to continue.

Maria K: recommend pinning model binary and kernel set on dedicated nodes to avoid heterogeneous execution paths. @Deploy-bot apply pin: v2.3.2-runtime-1.8.4 -> pinned.

Deploy-bot: pin applied to dedicated nodes. verification: all canary nodes report runtime-1.8.4 pinned.

Ops-oncall: confirmed pin. maintaining 30m post-deploy watch for production SLA.

Maria K: requesting final signoff to complete remaining traffic shift to 100% at 03:05Z. @Sam B @Bharat P @Lia M please reply.

Sam B: SGTM.

Bharat P: SGTM. I'll add a short rollback rationale to release notes (what to look for, how to revert).

Lia M: KMS OK, no pending rotations. +1.

Deploy-bot: initiating final shift. 100% traffic at 03:07Z. deployment complete. post-deploy summary: success. summary: https://redwood-internal/deploys/cassia/3245678901/summary

Maria K: leaving a runbook note: if progressive degradation is observed, immediate traffic split to 30% then full rollback to v2.3.1. documenting action items in the release notes. closing thread unless issues surface. :checkered_flag:
